name: freya-mcp
description: Locally authored Freya MCP stdio adapter for the Build the Builder workspace.

interface.longDescription: Launch the workspace's local Freya MCP server. Requires its Python virtual environment and supplied Freya credentials. Configuration and tool discovery must be checked after Codex reloads. This is a locally authored adapter, not an official Freya MCP distribution.
interface.defaultPrompt: Call freya_health and report configuration status before using Freya.
